tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Every display and menu background. Near-black; nothing sits on a lighter ground.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Panel frames, empty bar tracks, unlit keys, the trailing rail segment, row rules.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one accent: hex nodes, rails, sub-panel tabs, primary keys and primary data. Every station uses it.

tokens.name: amber-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary accent fills and unlit-but-present keys.

tokens.name: amber-hot
tokens.usage: Yellow Alert only: the accent pulses between amber and amber-hot.

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Red Alert only: replaces amber as the accent.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Secondary: neutral keys, the middle rail segment, secondary data series. Dims to #5D7F92 at Red Alert.

tokens.name: hero-white
tokens.usage: Values and primary text; the pressed key.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, codes and secondary text.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status only: ok.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Status only: warn.

tokens.name: status-alert
tokens.usage: Status only: alert, damage, offline.

tokens.name: seam-light
tokens.usage: Room lighting only: wall seams, coves and downlights. Never used on a display.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Display padding, as a share of the screen's short side (min 5px).

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between sub-panels, as a share of the content width.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between menu buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Menu padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything on a display. Corners are hex-cut, never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Only the outer edge of a station menu panel.

tokens.name: hex-cut
tokens.usage: A tab's angled end is cut back by 32% of its height (max a third of its width), giving the 60° hex profile used on keys, rails and bars.

tokens.name: node-inner
tokens.usage: The hex node's black core, as a share of its radius.
